headline: KRX activates sell-side sidecar for KOSPI on sharp decline
summary: Korea Exchange activated a sell-side sidecar for the KOSPI on Thursday after the benchmark index fell sharply. Sidecars are temporary trading pauses that apply when price moves exceed set thresholds.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main benchmark index, tracking the country's largest listed companies. Sidecar measures are designed to slow automated trading during sharp swings.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The index fell sharply, triggering the sell-side sidecar.
